svg.text: MNO(theta, IC, tokens) -- per-group shared MLP projection + FiLM-conditioned U-AFNO backbone
Linear(162, 128) + LN + ReLU + DO + Linear(128, 128) + LN
Per-level affine transform: gamma, beta = fc(param_emb)
U-Net encoder/decoder with AFNO blocks at each resolution level
L2: 32x32 | Upsample + cat(skip) + Conv2d(256, 128) + AFNO + ResNet x2
L1: 64x64 | Upsample + cat(skip) + Conv2d(128, 64) + AFNO + ResNet x2
L0: 128x128 | Upsample + cat(skip) + Conv2d(64, 32) + AFNO + Output Conv2d(32, 3, k=1)
Gradient checkpointing every N (Ex: 16) steps: recompute forward during backward to save memory
Peak memory: O(B * 16 * C * H * W) instead of O(B * 256 * C * H * W)
bptt_window=32, bptt_num_windows=3: gradients at N evenly-spaced windows across trajectory
Optional: + lambda_feat_mse * L_feat + lambda_centroid * L_centroid + lambda_ic * L_ic
Alternative: NeuralCA Backbone (~60K params vs U-AFNO ~145M)
Depthwise conv (perception) ➡ 1x1 conv (channel mix) ➡ MLP + softsign (growth) ➡ Euler update
Multi-scale perception: k=[3,7,7,7] d=[1,1,3,9] ➡ RF=[3,7,19,55] ➡ 128px coverage in 2 steps
Token codebook: 90 quantizers (30 grp x 3 lvl) | Per-group: 100D (64+24+12) ➡ shared MLP 64D ➡ mean pool ➡ refine 128D
Backbone channels: 32 ➡ 64 ➡ 128 ➡ 256 (bottleneck) | AFNO modes: 16 | Residual scale: 0.1
